scope: Existing Dioxus web/Linux native transport interactions and frameless Hyprland window
designSystem: Retained original bright mint/dark/light semantic tokens and SVG icons; no catalog kit/framework swap
principles: playback state machines and current-row toggles
pending operation intent and stale-source cancellation
tradeoff: Retain single audio owners and integrity/cancellation contracts. Linux loses the GTK title strip and gains integrated 44px window controls. Unsupported public/offline modes are explicitly limited rather than appearing active.
comprehensionLimits: Two scoped copy regions, not a whole-screen user study. The initial combined bundle counted mutually exclusive Play/Pause and unrelated window actions; not accepted as screen approval. Offline copy simplified.
